chapter: Own band, lake picnics, day jobs
title: Lake picnic schedules and music over the water
summary: He describes weekend picnic schedules at Milneburg and West End and how one band's music carried over the water to nearby camps.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: you know not one place all a lot of fraternity white picnics all on the lake well we used to have picnic sometime we'll leave home on the Saturday evening it'd get back to Tuesday morning you play a Saturday night dance from April 4th and you get out for a Sunday picnic at Millenburg get to hurry up and catch the train down there they call it the Smokey Joe go to Millenburg catch it on the Lyshenfield Avenue you know yeah but that's all day picnic now the time we come in and have a night dance either at the economy hall or hopes hall or for some other hall that's a night there say that's Sunday night Monday we probably be out at West End or Millenburg again all day picnic Monday night right back in town playing that night that make you be going from Saturday night till Tuesday morning you're talking about buying out that's about that job you know all through the week they used to have those picnics on the lake you know clubs have a dance here like you're playing at one dance now the club is really used to do this they want to know who want to have a band you know if a big club shouldn't charter one of those uh camps out there they they about some of them a block out over the water they used to have them I've seen pictures they still have some things not right there but they have some well if they know that club got a good band well then a lot of little clubs close by you know get the camps well they don't have to get a band they dance for a half a block each way all of them dancing from the same band oh I didn't know they did that I thought they all had their own band no there's sometimes you catch a band maybe about a block over there but they gave the free music that's
